items.title: The Home Depot Declares Quarterly Dividend of $2.33
items.summary: The Home Depot®, the world's largest home improvement retailer, today announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $2.33 per share. The dividend is payable on December 17, 2026, to shareholders of record on the close of business on December 3, 2026. This is the 159th consecutive quarter the company has paid a cash dividend.

items.title: Is Home Depot (HD) Undervalued Following Its Q3 Results Guidance Reset And CEO Change?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) just combined three big updates in one week, reporting third quarter results, tightening its 2026 outlook, and confirming a leadership reshuffle that puts longtime finance chief Richard McPhail in the CEO seat. Home Depot’s share price has had a choppy year, with a 1-month share price return of 8.96% that contrasts with a year-to-date decline of 2.37%.
